meta.name: entra-agent-id
meta.description: Provision Microsoft Entra Agent Identity Blueprints, BlueprintPrincipals, and per-instance Agent Identities via Microsoft Graph, and configure OAuth 2.0 token exchange (fmi_path, OBO, cross-tenant) including the Microsoft Entra SDK for AgentID sidecar. USE FOR: Agent Identity Blueprint, BlueprintPrincipal, agent OAuth, fmi_path token exchange, agent OBO, Workload Identity Federation for agents, polyglot agent auth, Microsoft.Identity.Web.AgentIdentities. DO NOT USE FOR: standard Entra app registration (use entra-app-registration), Microsoft Foundry agent authoring (use microsoft-foundry).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动化配置 Microsoft Entra 身份蓝图和令牌交换
copy.tagline_en: Automate Microsoft Entra identity blueprint provisioning and token exchange
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to provision Microsoft Entra Agent Identities and configure OAuth 2.0 token exchange

howto.what: 它让 Claude 通过 Microsoft Graph 为 AI 代理创建 Entra 身份:先建 Agent Identity Blueprint 和 BlueprintPrincipal,再建每个实例的 Agent Identity,并配置 OAuth 2.0 令牌交换(fmi_path、OBO、跨租户)。
howto.when: 当你需要为 AI 代理开通 Entra 身份、配置 agent OAuth 令牌交换,或排查 AADSTS82001 等 Agent ID 报错时,它会接管。标准 Entra 应用注册和 Foundry 代理编写不归它管。

say.text: 给这个 Agent Identity 授予 User.Read.All 应用权限
say.note: 通过 appRoleAssignments 完成授权

howto.what_en: It lets Claude provision Microsoft Entra Agent Identity Blueprints, BlueprintPrincipals and per-instance Agent Identities via Microsoft Graph, and set up OAuth 2.0 token exchange (fmi_path, OBO, cross-tenant).
howto.when_en: Triggers when you need Entra identities for AI agents, agent OAuth token exchange, or help with Agent ID errors like AADSTS82001. Not for standard Entra app registration or Foundry agent authoring.

say_en.text: Create an Agent Identity Blueprint and its BlueprintPrincipal for me
say_en.note: Calls Graph to create the app object and its service principal

say_en.text: Add an Agent Identity named agent-1 under this Blueprint
say_en.note: Creates a service-principal identity for one agent instance

say_en.text: Grant this Agent Identity the User.Read.All application permission
